clauses.clause: Explain concepts by interpreting texts.
Learn concepts by interpreting texts.
Construct texts to demonstrate understanding of concepts and processes.

verdicts.evidence:
- Display Summer Sun Risin' response sheet. Point out that this material has two parts. Tell students that today they will complete only Part 1, by writing and drawing about the main character and setting using key details from the text.
- -Direct students to the top of the page and point to Part 1 and read the title aloud:
- 'Use words and pictures to answer these questions.'
- -Point to the table below the title and read the headings of each column aloud:
- 'Who are the main characters?'
- 'Where does the story take place?'
- -Tell students that today they will answer these two questions using pictures and words to show their thinking.
verdicts.rationale: Students interpret the text to learn and explain concepts (main character, setting) and construct their own written and drawn responses, directly meeting all clauses.
verdicts.grounding_note: evidence quote found in lesson raw text
verdicts.standard_raw_text: Explain and learn concepts and processes by interpreting and constructing texts. (I/C)

verdicts.evidence:

- 'Who is the main character?' (the boy)
- 'Where does the story take place?' (a farm)
- Display Summer Sun Risin' response sheet. Point out that this material has two parts. Tell students that today they will complete only Part 1, by writing and drawing about the main character and setting using key details from the text.
verdicts.rationale: Students summarize (orally and in writing) key details about character and setting and visualize by drawing, meeting both clauses.

verdicts.evidence:
Tell students that today they will complete only Part 1, by writing and drawing about the main character and setting using key details from the text.
- -Direct students to the top of the page and point to Part 1 and read the title aloud:
- 'Use words and pictures to answer these questions.'
- -Point to the table below the title and read the headings of each column aloud:
- 'Who are the main characters?'
- 'Where does the story take place?'
- -Tell students that today they will answer these two questions using pictures and words to show their thinking.
- -Invite students to show a thumbs-up or to touch their head if they are ready to begin writing and drawing about the main character and setting.
